ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; the surface is dominated by low-intensity black pixels with high-intensity white/tan pixels limited to the distal tips and a small focal point at the median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark pigment across the majority of the visible 2D plane; localized high-contrast clusters at the left and right distal tips (coordinates: upper-left and upper-right peripheries); a single small, white triangular region at the central median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; calculated angle of approximately 48 degrees with a depth extending roughly 18% into the visible vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the majority of the trailing edge; a significant high-amplitude indentation (missing tissue) on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe; jagged, high-amplitude peaks concentrated at the right lobe tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave leading edges (partially submerged) with convex trailing edges that terminate in sharp, slightly upward-curved distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular tan and white pixel groups (barnacles) located at the extreme tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical and diagonal light-grey linear pixel disruptions visible across the mid-region of the left lobe; includes a high-contrast white circular ring on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large semicircular indentation on the left lobe's trailing edge suggesting significant tissue loss; prominent white circular ring scar on the left lobe roughly one-third of the distance from the tip; dense barnacle colonization on both lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique, high-contrast white concentric ring scar located on the dorsal/ventral surface of the left lobe.
